hook: Sergey works on programming languages and software verification. At the National University of Singapore he leads the Verified Systems Engineering lab, whose Veil and Velvet verifiers are built inside the Lean theorem prover, letting automation handle routine proof steps. He is a co-founder and the chief science officer of &Truth.
name: Ilya Sergey

quote.text: Trust in software should rest on independently checkable proof, not any company's word, including ours.

moniker: Associate professor at the National University of Singapore and chief science officer of &Truth

secondary.name: TokenPost, &Truth Raises $70 Million to Automate Formal Software Verification, 2026-10-29

timeline.event: Completes a PhD at KU Leuven (thesis: Operational Aspects of Type Systems)
Co-founds &Truth as Chief Science Officer; it emerges from stealth on October 29
timeline.impact: Lean-based verifiers move toward industrial use

quick_facts: Tenured Associate Professor, School of Computing, National University of Singapore, leading the Verified Systems Engineering lab
Co-Founder and Chief Science Officer of &Truth, PBC
PhD in Computer Science, KU Leuven; MSc in mathematics, St Petersburg University
Worked as a software engineer at JetBrains before academia

achievements.title: Veil and Velvet
achievements.impact: Extensible verifiers embedded in Lean, in which automation handles routine proof steps; cited by his co-founders as groundwork for &Truth.

achievements.title: POPL 2019 and PLDI 2021 Distinguished Paper Awards
achievements.impact: Recognized work on program synthesis for heap-manipulating programs and cyclic program synthesis.

achievements.title: Scilla
achievements.impact: Co-designed Scilla, a safer smart contract programming language.
